Minimalist Portfolio is a free multi page personal site template built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It ships with a home page, a blog that reads MDX files from a content folder, and a projects page, all sharing one quiet typographic system. Content is driven by config files in lib, so no component code needs to be touched to fill it in. Download, edit, and deploy to Vercel for a live portfolio in minutes.
